text:
Aria: Hi payroll/team — my Sep 20 paycheck had ~€2,400 withheld for PAYE/PRSI on my one-time relocation bonus. I was seconded to IE starting 2025-09-15 and uploaded the tax-treaty exemption paperwork on 2025-09-10 (see gm portal). I think the bonus should have been processed under US payroll with treaty relief, not Irish payroll. This is a big unexpected hit — can someone confirm what happened and if we can fix it quickly?

Sana (Payroll): Sorry Aria — that sounds bad. Can you paste the payrun id or link to the paystub? Also confirm the exact secondment effective date you see in Global Mobility. We'll triage.

Aria: paystub link: https://files.redwood.internal/paystubs/aria-0920.png. Payrun id shown on stub: payrun-20250920-07. GM shows secondment start 2025-09-15 and uploaded doc aria_secondment_20250910.pdf (tax treaty form).

Diego (Global Mobility): @Sana I can confirm we received Aria's signed secondment packet and tax paperwork on 2025-09-10 at 11:03. I just checked the GM upload log and the file is present. However I see the payroll integration log flagged the document as "unmatched" due to filename suffix mismatch. Pasting snippet below.

Sana (Payroll): if the integration didn't flag the treaty flag, our payroll mapping will treat the pay location as IE and apply Irish statutory deductions. We'll open an urgent ticket to re-run that payrun and do an off-cycle net adjustment.

TaxBot: Ticket #PR-2025-404 opened by Sana. Priority: high. Initial triage ETA 2 hours. Actions: confirm doc receipt, re-run payroll mapping, schedule off-cycle refund if needed, create supporting employer letter for local tax reclaim.

Diego (Global Mobility): integration log snippet:

```
2025-09-10T11:03:12Z gm-upload: user=aria, file=aria_secondment_20250910.pdf, status=uploaded
2025-09-10T11:03:14Z iam-sync: attempted to tag user metadata.tax_flag=true, result=filename_mismatch
2025-09-10T11:03:14Z iam-sync: expected file=aria_secondment_20250910_signed.pdf
2025-09-10T11:03:15Z payroll-webhook: payload={user: aria, location: IE, treaty_flag: false}
```

Sana (Payroll): thanks Diego. That explains it. We'll: 1) kick off reprocess of payrun-20250920-07 to remove Irish withholding on the bonus, 2) issue an immediate off-cycle net reimbursement for the withheld amount while reprocess completes, and 3) prepare documentation for Irish Revenue if a reclaim is needed.

Tom (Manager): Timeline? Aria flagged this as urgent for upcoming mortgage payment date. Can payroll confirm ETA for off-cycle?

Sana (Payroll): Off-cycle payout for net refund scheduled 2025-09-25 EOD (manual payroll check). Reprocess of the gross/tax is queued; if reprocess shows we were correct to apply treaty relief we'll reverse the Irish tax with a journal entry and reflect corrected employer submissions. If the Irish Paye filing already transmitted, we may need to request a reclaim via Revenue — payroll will assist.

Aria: Appreciate that. Will the correction affect year-end reporting (W-2 / Irish year-to-date)? Do I need to do anything for my personal filings?

Sana (Payroll): Short answer: we'll handle employer-side corrections and provide corrected payroll statements. For US year-end reporting, if the withholding was originally reported on a US W-2 and then reversed, payroll will assess whether a W-2C is necessary — we'll notify you. For Irish filings, if Revenue received PAYE entries, we'll provide a supporting employer letter and copies of corrected payroll runs to help you reclaim any overpayment. We'll loop Tax Ops if a cross-border reclaim request is needed.

TaxBot: PR-2025-404 update: off-cycle net refund check created (chk-OC-7582), amount €2,354. Expected clearing 2025-09-25. Reprocess job requeued (jobX-20250921-02).

Diego (Global Mobility): I've fixed the filename on the doc store (renamed to aria_secondment_20250910_signed.pdf) and retriggered metadata sync. Please confirm payroll mapping picks it up on reprocess.

Sana (Payroll): Confirmed: jobX-20250921-02 ran and mapping updated treaty_flag=true before re-processing payrun-20250920-07. Reprocess shows: bonus gross €6,000, Irish PAYE applied originally €2,120, corrected withholding should be €0 under treaty. Net delta €2,120 gross-tax delta matches off-cycle refund (difference due to currency rounding).

TaxBot: PR-2025-404 update: reprocess completed 2025-09-21T15:42Z. Off-cycle net refund cleared 2025-09-25T12:03Z (bank trace id BT-992113). Payroll statement updated and uploaded to employee portal: https://files.redwood.internal/paystubs/aria-0925-corrected.pdf

Aria: I see the off-cycle deposit hit my account. Thanks so much. I also downloaded the corrected statement.

Tom (Manager): thanks team. Two follow-ups: can we get a short runbook so GM knows the exact filename/metadata conventions to avoid this? And payroll — can we add a pre-payrun check for treaty_flag mismatch when a secondment doc exists within 14 days of a payrun?

Sana (Payroll): Agree on both. I'll draft a 1-page runbook and add a pre-payrun validation alert to the payroll pipeline to flag treaty documents that haven't been applied. Will share next week.

TaxBot: PR-2025-404 closed by Sana on 2025-09-25T14:20Z. Close notes: off-cycle net refund issued, payrun reprocessed to remove Irish withholding on bonus, corrected payroll statement uploaded, GM file naming conventions updated, runbook task created (DOC-2025-17).
